rationale: All six blocking findings from code-review.final are resolved by fix-up commits 459eb033..62c45617 (335-line diff). Each fix landed test-first (RED observed), and the full gates pass: lint, typecheck, build, 3159 unit tests. The isolated e2e on the rebuilt CLI confirms S1-S4, E1, E2 and CR-005 (a malformed global file stays byte-identical). No new high-risk issue in the fix-up diff. Accepted side effects, noted rather than blocking: a pending local migration now fills a versionless local file (spec B1 fill row) instead of failing; with a malformed global file, reads still list no profiles (pre-existing class from the stricter #575 guard, no data loss; malformed-global hardening is a non-goal).
